article_title: Scaffolding competence-based learning design in the dental simulation curriculum.
citation: Foxton Richard, San Diego Jonathan P., Lu Emily, Rajadurai Susha, Bartlett Anitha, McIlwane Clare, Austin Rupert, Srisontisuk Pinsuda, Sagoo Anika K., Piper Kim. (2025). Scaffolding competence‐based learning design in the dental simulation curriculum. European Journal of Dental Education. https://doi.org/10.1111/eje.12985
title: Paired dental simulation fidelity labs: haptics (SIMtoCARE) and phantom-head (A-dec) environments
description: The faculty operates two dental simulation fidelity labs used in the undergraduate curriculum. FL18-A houses 18 SIMtoCARE haptic task-trainer simulators with digital audio-visual technologies, integrating a phantom-head interface for a blended augmented reality learning experience, where teachers can demonstrate and observe students. FL20-B is fully integrated with 90 A-dec phantom heads, AV facilities and intra-oral scanners, offering a digitally augmented workflow combining lecture and laboratory as a complementary environment.
requirements: Both simulator types and AV facilities to support demonstration, observation and hands-on exercises
target_learning_goals: hands-on clinical skills exercises, tutorials and demonstrations in restorative dentistry
examples: Teachers can provide a demonstration using one of the SIMtoCARE simulators and observe students perform exercises
